Sandbox_PIP_EnableAutoWatering_tooltip: When on, pipes automatically water nearby crops from connected rain barrels.
Sandbox_PIP_WateringInterval_tooltip: In-game minutes between each watering cycle.
Sandbox_PIP_WateringRadius_tooltip: 0 = the pipe's own tile only. Higher values water crops in a square area around each pipe.
Sandbox_PIP_SmartPipes_tooltip: When on, pipes fill crops up to their optimal water level. When off, they add a fixed small amount each cycle.
Sandbox_PIP_SmartPipesFillMax_tooltip: Maximum water level added to a crop per cycle in Smart Pipes mode.
Sandbox_PIP_SharedWaterPool_tooltip: When on, barrels connected in the same network share and balance their water (a full and an empty barrel even out).
Sandbox_PIP_EnableFertigation_tooltip: When on, pour Fertilizer or Compost into a connected rain barrel and the pipe network auto-fertilizes nearby crops (one safe dose per crop, never over-fertilizes). On by default.
Sandbox_PIP_FertigationSkill_tooltip: Simulated Farming skill used when auto-fertilizing. Higher = better chance of a yield bonus. Does not affect safety.
Sandbox_PIP_ChargesPerBag_tooltip: How many crops one poured bag can fertilize. Independent of barrel water volume.
Sandbox_PIP_DebugLogs_tooltip: Prints internal logs to the console. For troubleshooting only.
